title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become "super-users" of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum's capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum's strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a "process expert" within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum's coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.

HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum's Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you'll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Fulkrum

title: Pessoa Mantenedora I
description:
Através de um portfólio completo com foco na descarbonização de infraestruturas de energia, a ENGIE oferece soluções integradas capazes de transformar cidades e empresas para que façam o melhor uso da energia baseadas em dois pilares: redução de custos e de emissões de CO2. Desta forma, as soluções customizadas de Autoprodução de energia Solar, Eficiência Energética, Subestações, HVAC, Geração de vapor, Consultoria e Gerenciamento de Energia atendem toda a cadeia otimizando a relação com a energia em diversos setores como Indústria, Shopping Centers, Varejo Multisites, Aeroportos, Hospitais, entre outros.

Para cidades, desenvolvemos projetos de Iluminação Pública e Mobilidade Elétrica tornando-as mais eficientes e colaborando na construção de uma sociedade mais sustentável e eficiente.

Com esta nova relação com a energia, mais otimizada e inteligente, a ENGIE é a líder mundial em transição energética, assumindo um importante papel neste cenário.

A ENGIE tem a responsabilidade constante na criação de um futuro harmonioso em conjunto com a população, gestores públicos e parceiros, rumo a uma economia neutra em emissões de carbono.

Missão do cargo: Operar e inspecionar sistemas e equipamentos, registrar parâmetros e ocorrências, executar rotinas de operação e manutenção, apoiar na gestão de materiais e serviços, garantindo a organização da planta, a conformidade técnica e a qualidade das entregas.

  • Realizar atividades de Operação e Manutenção utilizando software para cumprimento, abertura e fechamento de OS's, reportar problemas e desvios, avaliar estado geral da planta como organização, limpeza e conservação, realizar liberação de atividades próprias e de terceiros (APR, PT, Regrham, manobras de bloqueio, estado de EPI's), receber serviços, NF's, relatórios e materiais;
  • Produzir o relatório mensal de clientes;
  • Cadastrar materiais e criar requisições de materiais e serviços;Operar e inspecionar equipamentos e sistemas conforme instruções de trabalho, monitorar e registrar parâmetros de operação localmente ou via sistemas supervisórios (entendendo lógicas de funcionamento e conceitos básicos de mecânicas e elétricas), realizar registros precisos e comunicação de eventos, ocorrências e desvios.

Requisitos

  • Ensino médio técnico (Técnico em mecânica, eletrotécnica, eletromecânica, automação)

  • Desejável: (Conhecimento específicos equipamentos de utilidades, sistemas periféricos, instumentos e sistema de medição (EE, frio, vazão, pressão, etc)

Rio de Janeiro/RJ - Brasil

A ENGIE valoriza e estimula uma cultura de diversidade e inclusão, com orientação para igualdade entre as pessoas, respeito pela vida privada de todos e é contra qualquer forma de discriminação e assédio.

title: Sondador
description:
Resumo da função:
Responsável por realizar operações de perfuração e/ou intervenções de poços (workover) operando sondas, sejam elas hidráulicas ou convencionais; liderar as equipes em diversas atividades, com ou sem sonda, tais como: atividades Rig up/Rig & down (montagem e desmontagem), despressurização de poços, slick line, pescaria, wireline, dentre outras, visando pela segurança operacional, ambiental e da equipe.
Responsabilidades:
Conhecer e interpretar os principais dados específicos do poço (profundidade, pressão da formação, densidade do fluido de amortecimento, MAASP, etc), diagrama proposto de equipagem e o diagrama anterior para iniciar/dar continuidade as intervenções do tipo workover
Executar as atividades de assentamento de packer: mecânico e hidráulico, corte de cimento e tampões mecânicos (BPP e BPR) obedecendo e tendo conhecimento dos parâmetros necessários como peso sobre broca e circulação
Garantir a correta execução de atividades de equipagem com conjunto BCS obedecendo os cuidados necessários com a elevação das cargas para não ocorrer a flambagem, obedecendo os cuidados necessários com o manuseio e operação do cabo BCS, spooler, conectores elétricos (pig tail), instalação de clamps e alinhamento do orifício do PTS do suspensor com o adaptador A3EC
Executar inspeções nos equipamentos de manobra (colar de segurança, cunhas manuais e hidráulicas, elevadores de tubo, chave hidráulica) e de elevação (eslingas e cabos) bem como garantir sua integridade antes do início das operações
Realizar o check list diário de inspeção do sondador e garantir o correto preenchimento/inspeção dos demais check lists (torrista e plataformista) pela sua equipe orientando os demais sempre que necessário
Operar a sonda conhecendo os principais riscos inerentes ao tipo e a capacidade da sonda – em sonda convencional deve garantir a correta execução da tonelada milha
Executar e garantir a execução de todos os aspectos de segurança exigidos em atividades em área classificada, trabalho em altura, movimentação de cargas, testes hidrostáticos, H2S, equipamentos rotativos e segurança de poço
Planejar de forma antecipada todos os materiais e ferramentas necessários para a intervenção, bem como garantir a integridade dos equipamentos e ferramentas a bordo comunicando ao supervisor qualquer dano ocorrido
Garantir que a equipe siga rigorosamente o programa do poço atendendo todos os parâmetros exigidos bem como as normas vigentes de segurança operacional e de equipamentos de ESCP
Saber pesquisar e ter em mãos tabelas de cimentação, tabelas hidráulicas, manuais de perfurações, tabelas de tubos e revestimentos, etc.
Controlar todos os parâmetros operacionais do workover: peso sobre broca, densidade e viscosidade do fluido, vazão e pressão de bombeio
Exigências do Cargo:
Disponibilidade - Amplitude de horário – Plantão noturno - Trabalho Offshore 14x14
Experiência como Sondador de sondas tipo HH Drillmec e ou convencional à cabo 250.000lbs(tipo double joint/mesa rotativa) comprovados em carteira de trabalho;
Experiência comprovada em assentamento de tampões mecânicos e hidráulicos e obturadores (packers);
Experiência em equipagem de poço com coluna BCS;
Conhecimento teórico e prático na atividade de perfuração e/ou completação;
Escolaridade mínima:
Ensino médio técnico completo
Qualificação A: antes do embarque:
Curso Básico de Segurança de Plataforma - CBSP
Treinamento de Escape de Aeronave Submersa - HEUT
Well Control IWCF – Level 3
Programa de Capacitação em Segurança e Saúde no Trabalho - NR37 - Básico

title: Especialista de Controladoria
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar na controladoria societária com foco em normas contábeis nacionais e internacionais, assegurando a correta consolidação das demonstrações financeiras, conformidade regulatória e suporte técnico às auditorias externas e internas.

Apoiar processos de reestruturação societária, fusões, cisões e incorporações;
Atuar como ponto focal técnico junto às auditorias externas e internas, fornecendo suporte e documentação;
Realizar análises críticas de contas contábeis, conciliações e validações de saldos;
Participar de projetos de melhoria de processos contábeis, automação e compliance;
Interagir com áreas como jurídico, fiscal, planejamento e tesouraria para alinhamento de informações societárias;
Monitorar atualizações regulatórias e propor ajustes nos processos contábeis conforme necessário.

Especialização (desejável): Pós-graduação ou MBA em Controladoria, Contabilidade ou Finanças;
Experiência sólida em controladoria societária, consolidação contábil e elaboração de demonstrações financeiras;

title: Secretária
description:
SECRETÁRIA CRC | CLÍNICA ODONTOLÓGICA SORRISOS
REQUISITOS ELIMINATÓRIOS: EXPERIÊNCIA EM CLÍNICA MÉDICA OU ODONTOLÓGICA + RESIDIR NOS BAIRROS ESPECÍFICOS MENCIONADOS ABAIXO
QUEM SOMOS:
Em nossa clínica, transformamos vidas através de uma odontologia de excelência. Nossos valores fundamentais de honestidade, comprometimento, dedicação e qualidade guiam cada atendimento e procedimento que realizamos. Somos movidos pela missão de proporcionar saúde bucal de forma ética, humana e responsável, criando experiências únicas para nossos pacientes.
NOSSA VISÃO
Ser uma clínica referência em odontologia de excelência, proporcionando qualidade de vida e saúde bucal através de uma experiência única para nossos clientes. Aqui, cada paciente que chega com traumas e frustrações de experiências anteriores encontra acolhimento, profissionalismo e resultados transformadores.
A OPORTUNIDADE
Buscamos uma Secretária para nossa Central de Relacionamento com o Cliente (CRC) que compartilhe nossa paixão por transformar vidas e seja o primeiro sorriso acolhedor que nossos pacientes encontram ao chegar à clínica.
REQUISITOS ELIMINATÓRIOS:

  • Experiência comprovada em clínicas odontológicas ou médicas • Residir OBRIGATORIAMENTE a no máximo 8 km da clínica (exemplo nos bairros: Realengo, Bangu, Campo Grande, Santa Cruz, Sepetiba ou Itaguaí) • Disponibilidade para início imediato
    RESPONSABILIDADES:
  • Primeiro Contato: Ser a voz e o rosto acolhedor da nossa clínica, recebendo pacientes com empatia e alegria • Gestão de Agenda: Organizar e otimizar os horários dos profissionais, confirmando consultas e evitando faltas • Comunicação Efetiva: Orientar pacientes sobre tratamentos e procedimentos com clareza e segurança • Organização Impecável: Manter prontuários, documentos e sistema atualizados para garantir processos eficientes • Suporte Administrativo: Auxiliar na parte administrativa da clínica, contribuindo para o fluxo de trabalho otimizado
    O PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS:
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita • Organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas • Proatividade e resolução eficiente de problemas • Discrição e comprometimento com a confidencialidade • Habilidade com sistemas informatizados e pacote Office • Sorriso genuíno e capacidade de acolher pacientes mesmo em momentos de ansiedade
    POR QUE SE JUNTAR A NÓS?
  • Propósito Transformador: Fazer parte de histórias reais de transformação na vida das pessoas • Ambiente Inspirador: Trabalhar com uma equipe apaixonada e comprometida com a excelência • Desenvolvimento Profissional: Oportunidade de crescer com uma clínica em expansão • Cultura de Acolhimento: Ambiente que valoriza o bem-estar da equipe e dos pacientes
    INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS
  • Regime de Contratação: CLT • Local de Trabalho: CAMPO GRANDE.RJ • Horário: Segunda a sexta, horário comercial (disponibilidade para alguns sábados)

. Remuneração: R$ 2.000,00 + comissão e benefícios
COMO SE CANDIDATAR
Envie seu currículo para com o assunto "Secretária CRC - SORRISOS", destacando seu bairro de residência logo no início do e-mail.
IMPORTANTE: Currículos sem a informação do bairro de residência ou de candidatas residentes fora das áreas mencionadas não serão avaliados.
Se você acredita no poder de um sorriso para transformar vidas e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que trabalha com propósito, queremos conhecer você!

A Bram Offshore Transportes Marítimos é uma empresa do Grupo Edison Chouest Offshore e especializada no transporte marítimo de apoio à indústria de petróleo e gás no Brasil. Desde a chegada da primeira embarcação do Grupo Chouest, em 1991, a frota em operação no Brasil vem aumentando, já contando com mais de 70 embarcações altamente especializadas, de última geração.
Quer se juntar a nós e fazer parte do time de Manutenção?

· Colaborar na definição de estratégias da área de PPCM (Planejamento, Programação e Controle de Manutenção) alinhadas a necessidade da empresa.

· Gerenciar eventos de downtime com atualização periódica para a alta gestão).

Vaga: Analista de Operações de Benefícios Pleno (Foco em Faturamento)
Local de trabalho: Presencial – bairros na Baixada Fluminense (Nova Iguaçu, Belford Roxo) e Zona Norte do Rio (Méier, Campinho)
Horário: 08h30 às 17h, com 1h de almoço
Início desejado: 15/12/2025
Contrato temporário: 180 dias, com possibilidade de prorrogação até 270 dias
Sobre a oportunidade
Estamos buscando um Analista de Operações de Benefícios Pleno com forte experiência em faturamento para atuar no suporte às rotinas operacionais de benefícios (Saúde, Vida e Odonto), garantindo acuracidade, agilidade e organização nas demandas da área.
Responsabilidades principais
Organizar e executar rotinas operacionais com foco em faturamento de benefícios.
Dar suporte a clientes internos e externos em demandas de faturamento.
Atuar com processos de rateio, conferências, pagamentos e reembolsos junto às seguradoras.
Processar e analisar documentos complexos, realizar conferências de faturas, verificar divergências e preparar relatórios.
Utilizar Excel em nível intermediário/avançado (Tabelas Dinâmicas, PROCV, fórmulas SE, dashboards etc.).
Manter entendimento básico de seguros e legislações (incluindo aspectos regulatórios da ANS).
Contribuir para o atingimento de SLAs e KPIs da área.
Realizar movimentações cadastrais (inclusões, exclusões e alterações em planos).
Atender funcionários, RH e demais áreas internas.
Requisitos
Ensino Superior completo ou cursando.
Experiência com faturamento de operadoras/clientes (baixar, converter e conferir arquivos).
Conhecimento das normas da ANS.
Excel intermediário ou avançado, com experiência prática em rotinas de conferência de faturamento.

description:

Conhecimento do conceitos de Infraestrutura (Rede, firewall, WAF) e Noções de Banco de Dados (Oracle ou Postgres);
Disponibilidade para viagens, trabalhos finais de semana e em horários noturnos;
Facilidade de comunicação para ministrar treinamentos e relacionamento.
Não é obrigatório mas adoraríamos se...
Conhecimento em Linux;
Conhecimento básico de SoulMv;
Conhecimento básico de programação;
Conhecimento básico de língua espanhola.
O que você encontrará conosco:

  • Auxílio Creche;

  • Clube de Vantagens;
  • Desconto em Farmácia;

A MV é uma empregadora de oportunidades iguais. Entendemos que as diferenças tornam as pessoas únicas. Por isso, todos os candidatos qualificados independentemente de raça, cor, religião, idade, gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou constituição familiar, são bem-vindos.
Queremos te conhecer. Faça parte de nosso time.

Desenvolver e acompanhar os indicadores de desempenho

Local de trabalho: Centro do Rio de Janeiro
Sobre nós
Nossa história começou em 1932 e, desde então, acumulamos vasta experiência na prestação de assessoria jurídica a clientes nacionais e internacionais.
Somos um escritório de advocacia full service especializado nos setores de infra-estrutura, comércio e logística com destaque em direito marítimo, portos e infraestrutura, energia, óleo e gás, ambiental, ferroviário e setor público com foco em contencioso e arbitragem, tributário e aduaneiro, societário, regulatório, contratual, trabalhista e compliance,

Nosso propósito no Kincaid é criar uma equipe multidisciplinar, sempre pronta para entregar as melhores soluções jurídicas para os clientes.
Investimos nos nossos profissionais e no ambiente de trabalho buscando sempre o desenvolvimento de uma carreira transformadora!
No Kincaid respeitamos as individualidades e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferenças.
Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso!
Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Analista De Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
Apoiar revisõesfiscais de contratos;
Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.
Requisitos e qualificações
Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;

title: Financial Controller
description:
Financial Controller – Brazil
Location:
Rio de Janeiro
Employment Type:
Permanent | Full-time
Role Overview
A global financial services organisation is seeking a qualified Financial Controller to take full ownership of statutory, management, and operational finance for its Brazil entity. This is a standalone senior finance role with end-to-end accountability for financial control, regulatory compliance, reporting accuracy, systems optimisation, and cross-border financial governance.
The position operates as the primary financial authority for Brazil, acting as the key interface with global finance leadership, external auditors, tax authorities, and regional stakeholders. The role requires deep technical accounting expertise within a
regulated, multi-currency, international environment
, alongside hands-on ownership of financial systems, controls, and transformation initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Full ownership of end-to-end finance operations for the Brazil entity, covering general ledger, AP, AR, fixed assets, cash and balance sheet integrity.
Production of accurate and timely monthly management accounts, including detailed variance analysis, KPI reporting and financial performance commentary.
End-to-end responsibility for statutory reporting, including preparation and submission of annual financial statements and all federal and state tax filings.
Ownership of the month-end and year-end close process, including journals, reconciliations, balance sheet substantiation and audit readiness.
Development, implementation and ongoing monitoring of internal controls to ensure compliance with group policies, local regulation and audit standards.
Lead the full external audit process, acting as primary point of contact for auditors and resolving technical accounting and control issues.
Oversight of transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance in partnership with central tax teams.
Drive finance process improvement, automation and system optimisation across record-to-report, procure-to-pay and order-to-cash cycles.
Lead initiatives to reduce close timelines, improve working capital efficiency and enhance cash flow forecasting accuracy.
Act as finance lead for strategic projects including business growth, restructuring, system upgrades, new entity launches and M&A activity.
Key Requirements (Technical Only)
Fully qualified accountant:
CRC, CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA or international equivalent
.
Proven experience in
financial control, controllership or senior finance leadership
within a regulated, multi-entity environment.
Strong technical knowledge of
US GAAP and international accounting standards (IFRS / local GAAP)
.
Demonstrated experience leading
statutory reporting, audit management and regulatory compliance
.
Track record of operating in
multi-currency and cross-border finance environments
.
Hands-on experience with
financial systems and ERP platforms
(Workday or equivalent).
Practical experience with
transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance
.
Background in
financial services, professional services, or other regulated industries

international entities or regional finance operations
across multiple jurisdictions.

Who we are:
We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.
With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.
Join our family today.
Together, we'll make travel better.
About the job:
The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.
Operational Management:
Oversee daily operations across Plaza Premium Group portfolio. including partner lounges
Develop, implement, and continuously improve operational policies and procedures tailored to Plaza Premium Group within the Rio de Janeiro airport system, enhancing guest experience and operational efficiency.
Monitor and analyse performance metrics for all services, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing corrective actions
Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements and company policies, including, labour laws, health &safety, and airports standards.
Coordinate with other departments to guarantee integrated operations and outstanding guest satisfaction.
Own the customer experience and Net Promoter Score (NPS) across all customer touch points.
Financial Management:

Responsible for hiring, training and engagement.
Job Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in business, hospitality, real estate, or related field (MBA is plus)
Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory);

title: Analista De Inteligência De Negócios Pleno
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Aprofundar o conhecimento nos principais KPI’s da área de Gestão de Resultados & Indicadores (Vendas, Inadimplência, Concessões Comerciais, Alçadas) e suas respectivas políticas e diretrizes, propondo adequações, atualizações e melhorias;
  • Conhecer a Jornada dos times de Inteligência de Vendas & Recebíveis dos Shoppings ALLOS e suas necessidades para garantir as melhores soluções e definições estratégicas para a área de Gestão de Resultados & Indicadores;
  • Acompanhar, analisar, criticar, reportar e propor soluções para o resultado dos indicadores da área Gestão de Resultados & Indicadores;
  • Apoiar na gestão dos Programas de Engajamento da Cobrança e Políticas de Recuperação de Crédito através da elaboração de metas e desafios para os times de cobrança, além da elaboração de reports de acompanhamento dos indicadores;
  • Realizar interface com as áreas responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento de ferramentas, sistemas, processos, projetos da área de Gestão de Resultados & Indicadores;
  • Participar ativamente nos projetos de construção, atualização, estabilização dos sistemas e ferramentas que permeiam a área de Gestão de Resultados & Indicadores sendo parte importante na criação de regras e necessidades das ferramentas;
  • Promover melhorias através de treinamentos, materiais, atualizações de políticas e diretrizes que sustentam a área de Gestão de Resultados & Indicadores;
  • Identificar as demandas dos times de Inteligência de Vendas e Recebíveis e conectá-los com as áreas responsáveis (Faturamento, Cadastro, TI, Régua de Cobrança e etc);

title: Data Lead Engineer – Snowflake
description:
Title: Data Lead Engineer – Snowflake

Location: Remote Mexico/Brazi

Job Type: Contract

Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

- End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

- Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

- Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

- Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

- Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

- Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

- Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

- Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.


Qualifications


Required Skills:

- 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

- Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

- Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

- Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

- Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

- Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

- Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

- Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

- Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

- Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

- Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

- Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.


Preferred Skills:

- Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

- Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

- Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

- Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

- Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

- Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

title: Airport Operations Director
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide. Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards. Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team. Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to): Operational Leadership Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics. Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators. IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business. Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives. Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager. Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards. Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development. Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed. CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager. Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required. Team Development Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start. Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training. Compliance & QHSE Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement. Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements. Commercial Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed. Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects. Team Culture and Engagement Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives. Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team. Client Account Management Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary. Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities. Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department. Coordination Responsibilities Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment. Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments. Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins. Qualifications and Skills Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role. Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore. Proficient in MS Office;
CRM experience preferred. Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments. Personal Attributes Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking. Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary. Additional Information: This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth. Travel Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region. HSE Awareness: All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations. Why Join Us? This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector. We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated. Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation. Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

title: Analista De Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história. A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes. Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país. E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras. Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades. Responsabilidades e atribuições Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
Participar dadefinição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
Participar dadefinição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;
Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
Atendimento àfiscalização e auditoria;
Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária. Requisitos e qualificações Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;
Conhecimento em sistemas fiscais e ERPs SAP Diferencial. Informações adicionais O Que Temos Para Você

description: Modelo de trabalho: híbrido 2x por semana no escritório Localização: Escritório Central I Rio de Janeiro Regime de contratação: CLT + benefícios Buscamos um(a) profissional para ser o canal de comunicação entre a área de tecnologia e as áreas de negócio. title: Professor De Francês
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions
description:
Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and.>

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions in various locations to drive partnerships for licensing and embedding Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro into software and SaaS solutions.

Canonical supports ISV customers and alliances in building on Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro, which helps them deliver fast, reliable, secure, compliant and consistent solutions.

We offer the world's most extensive base of open source software, backed by comprehensive SLA support, FIPS‑certified cryptographic compliance, and security commitments that meet HIPAA and FedRAMP standards. We are the top‑rated operating system for developers. Partnering with every major public cloud provider, we ensure Ubuntu is optimized and seamlessly integrated with their unique services, making it easier for ISVs to deploy solutions confidently across multi‑cloud environments. Additionally, we collaborate with leading server manufacturers, IoT providers, and silicon vendors to enable, optimize, and certify Ubuntu on their hardware. This makes Ubuntu an exceptional choice for ISVs selling physical appliances or traditional software solutions.

The world's biggest brands in AI build on these Ubuntu Pro capabilities to ensure they stay focused on their product proposition rather than maintenance or compliance.

Location

Multiple openings in the Americas and in E time zones.

Role Overview

The Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions will collaborate with Product, Alliances, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing colleagues to prospect into ISV accounts, introduce our offerings, and help partners or potential customers develop their products to best leverage our portfolio. The successful candidate will:

  • Drive embedded support and licensing sales with ISVs to exceed quarterly and annual booking targets.
  • Lead customer and partner relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales, customer success and support lifecycle.
  • Deepen understanding and engagement with the open source ecosystem.
  • Identify and develop partnerships that support Canonical's strategic ambitions.
  • Collaborate with product management to ensure fitness and enhancement of our platforms and solutions for ISVs.
  • Negotiate contracts with new and existing ISV partners and customers.
  • Shape our content and messaging for ISV partners and customers.

What We Are Looking For

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about an alternative chosen path.
  • Ability to establish strategic relationships with large organisations at all levels.
  • A passion for technology and extensive experience with the software and SaaS industry, Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred), the open source ecosystem, cloud models, and container service offerings.
  • Experience with lead generation and business development in the software sector.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.
  • Outstanding business English writing and presentation skills.
  • A personal drive to meet commitments and a track record of delivering beyond expectations.
  • A commitment to leadership, skills development and mentorship.
  • An appreciation of diversity and effectiveness in a multicultural, multi‑national organisation.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

What We Offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Howard University is seeking a Chief Audit Officer (CAO) who serves as the institution’s senior audit executive, leading the internal audit function with authority and independence to provide objective assurance and advisory services across all university operations. The CAO plays a critical role in protecting institutional assets, enhancing operational effectiveness, and supporting the achievement of strategic objectives through systematic evaluation and improvement of risk management, internal controls, and governance processes.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Audit Execution

  • Develop and annually update a comprehensive, risk‑based internal audit plan aligned with the university’s strategic priorities, emerging risks, and compliance requirements
  • Present the annual audit plan to the Audit Committee for review and approval, adapting priorities dynamically in response to changing institutional needs
  • Direct and oversee all internal audit engagements, including financial, operational, compliance, information technology, and investigative audits
  • Ensure audit work is performed in accordance with the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (IIA Standards)
  • Implement and maintain a quality assurance and improvement program, including periodic external assessments
  • Coordinate audit activities with external auditors and regulatory agencies to maximize coverage and minimize redundancy

Reporting & Communication

  • Prepare and present comprehensive audit reports to the President, senior leadership, and Audit Committee, including findings, risk ratings, and actionable recommendations
  • Communicate significant risk exposures, control deficiencies, and governance concerns to the Audit Committee in a timely and transparent manner
  • Provide quarterly status reports on audit plan progress, emerging risks, follow‑up on prior recommendations, and resource utilization
  • Meet privately with the Audit Committee without management present to discuss sensitive matters
  • Review audit workpapers, findings, and reports to ensure quality, accuracy, and appropriate support for conclusions

Risk Management & Advisory Services

  • Conduct ongoing enterprise risk assessments in collaboration with senior leadership to identify and prioritize audit areas
  • Monitor the institutional risk environment, including emerging risks related to technology, cybersecurity, research integrity, Title IX, athletics, sponsored programs, and student services
  • Provide advisory services and consultation on new systems, processes, policies, and strategic initiatives from a risk and control perspective
  • Track regulatory and legal developments affecting higher education, including federal and state requirements, accreditation standards, and grant compliance
  • Facilitate training and awareness programs on internal controls, fraud prevention, ethics, and risk management

Investigations & Special Projects

  • Lead or oversee investigations into allegations of fraud, financial irregularities, policy violations, or misconduct with appropriate confidentiality and due process
  • Coordinate with Human Resources, General Counsel, and law enforcement as appropriate during investigations
  • Conduct special projects and ad hoc reviews at the request of the Audit Committee, President, or senior leadership

Independence & Professional Standards

  • Maintain organizational independence and individual objectivity in all audit activities, free from interference in determining scope, performing work, and communicating results
  • Uphold the IIA Code of Ethics and maintain professional skepticism in all engagements
  • Ensure the internal audit function has unrestricted access to records, personnel, and physical properties relevant to audit activities
  • Avoid conflicts of interest and recuse from audits where independence may be compromised

Team Leadership & External Coordination

  • Recruit, supervise, mentor, and evaluate internal audit staff, fostering professional development and maintaining a high‑performing team
  • Promote continuing professional education and certification for audit staff
  • Manage the internal audit budget and allocate resources effectively to achieve audit plan objectives
  • Serve as the primary liaison with external auditors for financial statement audits, federal compliance audits (Single Audit), and NCAA agreed‑upon procedures
  • Manage relationships with external firms engaged for specialized audits or consulting services

Qualifications

Education

  • Required: Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or related field
  • Preferred: Master's degree in accounting, business administration (MBA), public administration (MPA), or related discipline

Certifications

  • Required: At least one of the following professional certifications:
    • Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
    • Certified Public Accountant (CPA)
    • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
  • Preferred: Multiple relevant certifications demonstrating breadth of expertise

Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive internal audit experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership or management role
  • Demonstrated experience in higher education, public sector, nonprofit, or similarly complex organizational environments strongly preferred
  • Proven track record of developing and executing risk‑based audit plans and managing audit engagements from planning through reporting
  • Experience presenting audit findings and recommendations to audit committees or boards of directors

Knowledge & Skills

  • Comprehensive understanding of the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing and the COSO Internal Control Framework
  • Strong knowledge of governance, enterprise risk management, and compliance frameworks (e.g., COSO ERM, ISO 31000)
  • Familiarity with higher education regulations including Title IV financial aid, OMB Uniform Guidance, research compliance, NCAA rules, and FERPA
  • Proficiency in data analytics tools and audit management software
  • Understanding of information technology controls, cybersecurity risks, and IT audit methodologies
  • Knowledge of fraud detection and prevention techniques

Competencies

  • Leadership: Ability to lead and inspire a professional team, influence organizational change, and navigate complex institutional environments
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with ability to present complex information clearly to diverse audiences
  • Analytical Thinking: Strong critical thinking, problem‑solving, and analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Relationship Building: Diplomatic and collaborative approach, with ability to build trust and credibility across all organizational levels
  • Integrity: Unwavering commitment to ethical conduct, objectivity, and professional standards
  • Judgment: Sound decision‑making ability and professional skepticism, balanced with pragmatism and business acumen
  • Adaptability: Flexibility to manage changing priorities, emerging risks, and resource constraints in a dynamic environment

This role will establish standardized workflows, ensure research administrators receive ongoing training, and work closely with Associate Deans and faculty to troubleshoot issues. The Associate Director will also lead monthly research administration meetings to facilitate training, updates, and process improvements.

Oversight & Management

  • Works closely with Deans, Associate Deans, and PIs to monitor and enhance grant support services.

    • Proposal development & sponsor guidelines
    • Budgeting & financial management
    • Workday grants system workflows
    • Federal compliance & university policies
  • Leads monthly 3‑hour research administration meetings, providing updates, training, and addressing concerns raised by administrators and faculty.

Performance Management & Feedback

  • Develops and implements performance metrics for tracking research administration effectiveness across colleges.

Collaboration & Troubleshooting

Minimum Requirements

About Solution Seeker

Solution Seeker - with headquarters in Norway and a subsidiary in Brazil - is a scaleup building software and AI for industrial production optimization, turning data into value and strategic insight for our users.

Our software streams live sensor data from production facilities worldwide, processed in an event-driven, distributed system using patented algorithms to identify stable periods and select the most valuable data points for our machine learning models.

On top of this, we develop applications that help customers visualize and contextualize their data with our predictions and analyses, enabling them to make better production decisions. Beyond client work, we dedicate significant time and resources to cutting-edge machine learning research, including generative and probabilistic modeling, hybrid modeling (combining physics and ML), data-driven production optimization, and closed-loop identification.

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with our data and play a key role in addressing some of the most important technical and strategic challenges we face. Your tasks may include:

  • Analyzing large volumes of production data to solve real customer challenges
  • Developing and optimizing our machine learning models
  • Designing and building applications based on customer needs
  • Preparing and delivering insightful presentations internally and externally
  • Contributing to strategic initiatives such as go-to-market plans, positioning, and delivery models

You’ll develop both technical and business expertise in a growing scaleup, giving you a strong foundation for future growth, whether you aim to specialize technically, move into business roles, or step into leadership.

About you

In addition to being technically skilled, you are naturally curious and never back down from a challenge. You are generous and accountable, always seeking to include others rather than exclude them. Your playful nature and willingness to contribute to the work environment make you a valuable team member because you know that happy developers mean happy customers.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. Join us and be part of a team that embraces curiosity, warmth, playfulness, and punchiness as we create groundbreaking solutions and strengthen our position as world-leading experts in our field

Requirements

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese , both written and spoken (English will be your main working language)
  • Willingness to live 12 months in Oslo, Norway (from Feb 2026) and return to Rio to join the Brazilian team once your initial rotation is over.

  • Basic understanding of programming and strong logical reasoning skills
  • Ability to take initiative and deliver results
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Being Brazilian or possessing a valid work permit to work in Brazil (once your rotation in Oslo is over)
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field
  • Our tech stack is large and we do not expect you to know all of it, but any familiarity would be greatly appreciated skills
  • Familiarity with Python
  • Experience working with large datasets
  • Experience/knowledge of Plotly Dash
  • Experience studying or working abroad
  • Experience with simulation, optimization, and modeling
  • Master’s degree in engineering or a related field

What we offer

To give you the best possible start before joining our Rio de Janeiro team, you’ll spend your first year with us at our headquarters in Oslo, where you’ll get a full onboarding into the company, our people, and our way of working. We will provide assistance related to obtaining the necessary visas/work permits before you can relocate to Oslo, and we will offer a competitive remuneration package for your stay in Norway, so you can focus on learning, contributing to the company, and enjoying the experience.

At Solution Seeker, we believe work should be both meaningful and fun. You’ll have the freedom to shape your own workday, with opportunities to explore different teams and projects based on your interests.

Our culture is young, social, and collaborative—we enjoy lunch runs, after-work beers, company trips. Once back in Rio, you’ll carry that spirit with you, working closely with our Oslo team while enjoying the energy of our Brazilian office (and yes, the beaches are right there when you need them).

Senior Legal Counsel (Unconventional Gas) – Relocate to Saudi Arabia

Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Senior Legal Counsel to join the Gas Corporate & Commercial Legal Practice in the Upstream Law Department within the Aramco Law Organization.

The Gas Corp & Commercial Legal Practice provides legal support to the company’s upstream unconventional gas business, including drilling, production, processing and day-to-day operations as well as related joint ventures and subsidiaries.

As Senior Counsel, your primary role is to provide comprehensive corporate and commercial legal services, working closely with internal stakeholders and coordinating with specialist legal teams in areas such as tax, intellectual property (IP), mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and dispute resolution. The role will require collaboration with external legal counsel as needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts and legal agreements.
  • Provide strategic legal advice to internal clients, identifying and mitigating potential legal risks while supporting business objectives.
  • Lead or support multidisciplinary legal and commercial projects, ensuring timely and effective delivery.
  • Advise on claims management and dispute resolution processes.
  • Serve as Board Secretary for designated joint ventures and subsidiaries.
  • Manage relationships with external legal counsel, including oversight of legal budgets and service quality.

Required Qualifications

  • A Bachelor of Law degree as minimum. Master or Juris degree preferred.
  • Current admission to general practice before the highest court of the state or country of which you are a citizen or resident.
  • A minimum of 10 years experience gained in a sophisticated law firm or corporation. Preferably within a major international or national energy company or oilfield services organization.
  • Demonstrated in-depth understanding of the upstream oil and gas industry, particularly unconventional gas operations.
  • Proven ability to negotiate complex commercial agreements and deliver clear, practical legal advice to business clients.

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Oil Reservoir Management Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
